The '''Reidi Artom museum''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The building was situated next to a statue of [[Reidi Artom]], a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] explorer who discovered the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]].
